data.title: Bayern concedes fastest Bundesliga goal, Rayo game called off, and Arsenal bounces back - ABC News
data.content:
# Bayern concedes fastest Bundesliga goal, Rayo game called off, and Arsenal bounces back

Bayern Munich goalkeeper Manuel Neuer has given away the Bundesliga’s fastest ever goal

ByCIARÁN FAHEY Associated Press and JOSEPH WILSON Associated Press

October 10, 2026, 11:48 AM [...] Livan Burcu scored late for Union Berlin to beat promoted Elversberg 1-0 for its first win of the season.

Also, Miro Muheim scored in stoppage time for Hamburger SV to win at Hoffenheim 3-2, and Stuttgart enjoyed a 2-0 win in Paderborn.

Leipzig hosted Eintracht Frankfurt later.

Rayo fans forced a suspension of their team's match against Athletic Bilbao by repeatedly throwing paper airplanes and other objects onto the field in protest against club owner Raúl Martín Presa. [...] Bayern coach Vincent Kompany said his team’s visit to Augsburg was a “priority game” after its only league loss against Augsburg in Munich last season, but he can’t have imagined making a worse start to what ultimately ended in a 2-2 draw — the second time in five games that Bayern has dropped points this season.

It began with Bayern playing the ball back from the kickoff to Neuer, who botched his attempt at a chipped clearance and allowed Robin Fellhauer to score after just eight seconds.
